aggressive_definition: Aggressive prostate cancer (APC); no further clinicopathologic definition is provided in the abstract.
aggressive_definition_excerpt: Diet and body size may affect the risk of aggressive prostate cancer (APC), but current evidence is inconclusive.
study_design: Case-control study of aggressive prostate cancer cases and biopsy-confirmed prostate-cancer-free controls
reason: The case-control study directly evaluates risk factors for aggressive prostate cancer. The abstract reports 1,254 APC cases and 818 controls but does not state a total analytic sample, so total N was not calculated.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Intakes of milk and all dairy products were inversely associated with APC risk (0.71, 9.53-0.96, P<sub>trend</sub> = 0.05, and 0.64, 0.48-0.87, P<sub>trend</sub> = 0.012, respectively), but there was little evidence of an association with other dietary variables (P<sub>trend</sub> > 0.05).
estimate_classifications.reason: The all-dairy-products OR of 0.64 is explicitly reported for aggressive prostate cancer risk.
